title: FrameRouter: Frame Budget Routing for Long-Video Understanding on Video-MME-v2 and Beyond
abstract: arXiv:2611.23055v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-video question answering benchmarks like Video-MME-v2 typically evaluate systems under a uniform frame budget for every question, despite stark variation in the evidence each query actually demands. We analyze this mismatch on Video-MME-v2 and find that different question subsets prefer different frozen frame-budget policies, while uniformly increasing the frame count does not reliably improve all metrics. These findings motivate fixed-mean frame-budget routing, a controlled inference setting in which each question may receive a different frame budget while the average budget matches a uniform reference. We introduce FrameRouter, a training-free test-time framework that combines an evidence-demand router, a budget-constrained allocation rule, and a frozen bank of frame-sampling policies. translated_title: FrameRouter：面向长视频理解的帧预算路由方法——基于Video-MME-v2及更多基准
translated_abstract: 像Video-MME-v2这样的长视频问答基准，通常在为每个问题分配统一帧预算的条件下评估系统，然而各个查询实际所需的视觉证据存在显著差异。我们在Video-MME-v2上分析了这种不匹配现象，发现不同的问题子集各自偏好不同的固定帧预算策略，而简单地统一增加帧数量并不能可靠地改善所有指标。这些发现启发我们提出了“固定均值帧预算路由”这一受控推理设置：每个问题可以分配到不同的帧预算，同时整体平均预算与统一预算的参考设置保持一致。我们提出FrameRouter，一个无需训练的测试时框架，它结合了证据需求路由器、预算约束分配规则以及一组固定的帧采样策略库。通过在保持底层采样器不变的前提下控制每个问题所获得的视觉证据量，FrameRouter与查询（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出无需训练的测试时框架FrameRouter，通过证据需求路由器为每个问题动态分配不同的帧预算（保持平均预算与统一参考一致），从而更有效地提升长视频问答的准确性。
en_tdlr: FrameRouter is a training-free test-time framework that routes different frame budgets to each question according to its evidence demand while keeping the mean budget fixed, improving long-video question answering on Video-MME-v2 and beyond.
